# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in this project!

## ⚠️ Source-Available Repository

This repository operates under an All Rights Reserved license. However, we **do** welcome community contributions for bug fixes and improvements!

### What this means

| Action | Accepted? |
| :--- | :---: |
| Opening a PR for improvements/fixes | ✅ |
| Forking the code (strictly to make a PR) | ✅ |
| Forking the code to deploy/run it yourself | ❌ |
| Reporting a **security vulnerability** | ✅ → See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) |
| Reporting a **bug** via GitHub Issues | ✅ |
| Asking technical questions via Issues | ✅ |

### Legal Note for Contributors

By submitting a Pull Request to this repository, you agree to assign the copyright of your contributed code to the repository owner (losperris.dev). This ensures the project can safely remain under its current license.

## Reporting Bugs

If you spot a bug in the source code or the live instance at [ttv.losperris.dev](https://ttv.losperris.dev), please open a GitHub Issue using the **Bug Report** template. Provide as much detail as possible:

- What you expected to happen
- What actually happened
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)

## Reporting Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security reports.** Please follow the responsible disclosure process described in [`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).

---

*Thank you for respecting these boundaries and for taking the time to audit the code responsibly.*
